_comment: Release profiles: which regression run specs belong to each release type. A profile may 'extends' another to inherit its specs. 'common' is a shared base holding the specs every release runs — it is not meant to be run directly. 'full' is NOT a superset of 'partial': Directory Connector (BWDC) runs on partial releases only, so both profiles extend 'common' rather than full extending partial. Spec names are file names in specs/ without the .json extension.
